questions.prompt: What did the meeting bring together?
options: Plans to move fishing boats abroad and reduce local research.
Different fishing experiences and evidence for future management.
A new seafood market and a final list of rules for its sellers.
A survey of seafood buyers and a plan to change port prices.
questions.explanationZh: 会议把不同从业者的经历与研究证据放在一起，用于未来管理；未决定最终规则，也不是消费者或市场价格调查。

questions.prompt: What do the figures of around 220 and over 3,700 tonnes refer to?
options: Shellfish eaten by octopuses along the south-west coast.
Octopus stocks counted by scientists across British waters.
Seafood sold by British businesses to overseas customers.
Octopus catches landed by UK vessels in UK ports.
questions.explanationZh: s4说明船只与港口范围，s5明确这些是上岸渔获物而非海中章鱼总量。

questions.prompt: Why did some participants raise safety concerns?
options: More boats were fishing in the same areas.
Fishing boats had begun travelling farther from the coast.
Ports had changed the way they recorded catches.
Scientists had asked boats to catch larger shellfish.
questions.explanationZh: 安全担忧与更多船只集中于相同渔场有关，其他原因未在文中出现。

questions.prompt: Which account of the next stage matches the article?
options: International examples will replace information from local fishermen.
The new rules will be published before the discussion summary.
A discussion summary will help shape later decisions.
The rise in landings will be treated as a full count of octopuses.
questions.explanationZh: 摘要将为后续决策提供信息；文中没有说国际经验替代本地经验、已有新规则或上岸量就是种群总量。
